arxiv-2112-08269.title: Double Bubbles with High Constant Mean Curvatures in Riemannian Manifolds
arxiv-2112-08269.creator: Gianmichele Di Matteo, Andrea Malchiodi
arxiv-2112-08269.description: Abstract . We obtain existence of double bubbles of large and constant mean curvatures in Riemannian manifolds. These arise as perturbations of geodesic standard double bubbles centered at critical points of the ambient scalar curvature and aligned along eigen-vectors of the ambient Ricci tensor.

arxiv-2209-10322.title: Adversarial Formal Semantics of Attack Trees and Related Problems
arxiv-2209-10322.creator: Thomas Brihaye, Sophie Pinchinat, Alexandre Terefenko
arxiv-2209-10322.description: Abstract Security is a subject of increasing attention in our actual society in order to protect critical resources from information disclosure, theft or damage. The informal model of attack trees introduced by Schneier, and widespread in the industry, is advocated in the 2008 NATO report to govern the evaluation of the threat in risk analysis.

arxiv-2301-07200.title: Statistics of tidal and deformation eigenvalue fields in the primordial Gaussian matter distribution: the two-dimensional case 2023 Statistics of tidal and deformation eigenvalue fields in the primordial Gaussian matter distribution: the two-dimensional case – References
arxiv-2301-07200.creator: Job Feldbrugge, Yihan Yan, Rien van de Weygaert
arxiv-2301-07200.description: Abstract We study the statistical properties of the eigenvalues of the primordial gravitational tidal and deformation tensor for random Gaussian cosmic density and velocity fluctuation fields. With the tidal and deformation tensors, Hessians of the gravitational and velocity potential, being Gaussian, the corresponding eigenvalue fields are distinctly non-Gaussian.

arxiv-2305-10891.title: DIFFUSION-BASED MEL-SPECTROGRAM ENHANCEMENT FOR PERSONALIZED SPEECH SYNTHESIS WITH FOUND DATA
arxiv-2305-10891.creator: Yusheng Tian, Wei Liu, Tan Lee
arxiv-2305-10891.description: Abstract Creating synthetic voices with found data is challenging, as real-world recordings often contain various types of audio degradation. One way to address this problem is to pre-enhance the speech with an enhancement model and then use the enhanced data for text-to-speech (TTS) model training.

arxiv-2405-00422.title: Bona-Smith-type systems in bounded domains with slip-wall boundary conditions: Theoretical justification and a conservative numerical scheme
arxiv-2405-00422.creator: Dimitrios Antonopoulos, Dimitrios Mitsotakis
arxiv-2405-00422.description: Abstract . Considered herein is a class of Boussinesq systems of Bona-Smith type that describe the propagation of long surface water waves of small amplitude in bounded two-dimensional domains with slip-wall boundary conditions and variable bottom topography. Such boundary conditions are necessary in situations involving water waves in channels, ports, and generally in basins with solid boundaries.

arxiv-2507-16707.title: Simulating realistic Lyman- α \alpha emitters including the effect of radiative transfer
arxiv-2507-16707.creator: Hasti Khoraminezhad 1, Shun Saito 1,2, Max Gronke 3,4, Chris Byrohl 2,5
arxiv-2507-16707.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hasti Khoraminezhad 1, Shun Saito 1,2, Max Gronke 3,4, Chris Byrohl 2,5. We present an empirical yet physically motivated simulation of realistic Lyman- α \alpha emitters (LAEs) at z ∼ − 3 z\sim 2\!-\!3 , crucial for ongoing and forthcoming cosmological LAE surveys. We combine an empirical UniverseMachine galaxy-halo model with a simple spherical expanding shell model for the Lyman- α \alpha radiative transfer, calibrating only three free parameters to simultaneously reproduce the observed Lyman- α \alpha luminosity function and the angular clustering.

arxiv-2508-00646.title: Pull Requests From The Classroom: Co-Developing Curriculum And Code Conference: Mensch und Computer 2025; August 31-September 03, 2025; Chemnitz, Germany Mensch und Computer 2025 (MuC ’25), August 31-September 03, 2025, Chemnitz, Germany DOI: 10.1145/3743049.3748581 ISBN: 979-8-4007-1582-2/25/08 CCS

arxiv-2508-00646.description: Abstract . Educational technologies often misalign with instructors’ pedagogical goals, forcing adaptations that compromise teaching efficacy. In this paper, we present a case study on the co-development of curriculum and technology in the context of a university course on scientific writing.

pmc-12438264.title: Preliminary evaluation of the psychometric properties of the Italian version of the Psychotic Symptom Rating Scales (PSYRATS)
pmc-12438264.creator: S. Costantini, A. Di Lisi, L. Ghidetti, F. Cappella, L. Orlando, F. Catalano, M. Benassi, R. P. Sant’Angelo
pmc-12438264.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionMost of the validated Italian scales for assessing psychotic symptoms don’t analyze specific symptoms like delusions and hallucinations in detail, but rather measure a wide range of experiences and behaviors in a general way. Scales such as PANSS, SAPS, and Sistema3 include only a few items on delusions and hallucinations, without considering the multidimensional characteristics of these symptoms, such as the degree of conviction, distress, duration, and perceived reality of the hallucinations.

pmc-12739473.title: An Ex Vivo Lung Histoculture Model for Studying Pulmonary Infection and Immune Response With SARS-CoV-2 as an Example of RNA Virus
pmc-12739473.creator: Elena V Maryukhnich, Daria M Potashnikova, Daria A Vorobyeva, George I Rusakovich, Anna V Tvorogova, Anna I Kalinskaya, Natalia V Pinegina, Anna V Kovyrshina, Inna V Dolzhikova, Alexander B Postnikov, Fedor N Rozov, Tatiana N Sotnikova, Dmitry Yu Kanner, Denis Yu Logunov, Alexander L Gintsburg, Elen
pmc-12739473.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The tissue explant culture (histoculture) is a method that involves maintaining small pieces taken from an organ ex vivo or post mortem in a controlled laboratory setting. Such a technique has a number of advantages: unlike the 2D, organoid, or on-chip cultures, tissue explants preserve the whole complexity of the original tissue in vivo, its structure, extracellular matrix, and the diverse cell populations, including resident immune cells.

pmc-12745117.title: The influence of socioeconomic status on the decision to use bilateral internal mammary artery grafting in coronary artery bypass surgery
pmc-12745117.creator: Yu Hohri, Tanner Powley, Chunhui Wang, Pengchen Wang, Paul Kurlansky, Koji Takeda
pmc-12745117.description: ObjectiveThe influence of socioeconomic status on the decision to use bilateral internal mammary artery (BIMA) grafting versus single IMA (SIMA) grafting remains uncertain. In this study, we examine the association between Distressed Communities Index scores and the decision to use BIMA grafting.

pmc-13493990.title: Research on a multi-strategy enhanced parrot optimization algorithm STPO for Complex optimization problems and its applications
pmc-13493990.creator: MingXuan Jian, GuoZhen Wu, BangLing Xiao
pmc-13493990.description: Metaheuristic optimization algorithms are widely used to tackle complex, high-dimensional, and nonlinear problems by mimicking natural or social behaviors, showing great potential for future development. Among them, the Parrot Optimization (PO) algorithm, inspired by the green-cheeked conure, exhibits strong adaptability. However, in high-dimensional scenarios, it often converges slowly and is prone to getting trapped in local optima.
